records.source: Ah, it feels good here in the shade.
I had some extra wood, so I made these mini bookcases...
records.translation: 我有一些多餘的木材，所以做了這些迷你書櫃……

records.source: Oh, um... these are some model planes I built... do you like them?
records.translation: 噢，呃……這些是我做的飛機模型……你喜歡嗎？

records.source: Psst... I'm selling eggs for cash! Hehe... Don't tell Lewis.
records.translation: 噓……我在賣蛋換現金！嘿嘿……別告訴路易斯。

records.source: Want my old broken skateboard? I guess you could use it for decoration or something.
records.translation: 想要我那塊壞掉的舊滑板嗎？我想你可以拿來當裝飾之類的。

records.source: I found some stuff by the lake.
records.translation: 我在湖邊找到了一些東西。

records.source: Hello. I hope you see something you like.
records.translation: 你好。希望你能看見喜歡的東西。

records.source: In the mood for something delicious?
Some interesting things washed up on the beach. Care to trade?
records.translation: 海灘上沖來了一些有趣的東西。想交換嗎？

records.source: You'd better go find more eggs so you can buy all my stuff!
records.translation: 你最好多找些蛋，這樣才能買下我所有的東西！

records.source: Do you have any eggs to trade? I'm studying the composition of the shell.
records.translation: 你有蛋可以交換嗎？我正在研究蛋殼的組成。

records.source: Hey, check out this custom wallpaper I made. Want it?
records.translation: 嘿，看看我特製的壁紙。想要嗎？

records.source: Hehehe... Found some old beverages in the back of the fridge.
records.translation: 嘿嘿嘿……我在冰箱深處找到了一些老飲料。

records.source: Hi! I hope you find something you like.
records.translation: 嗨！希望你能找到喜歡的東西。

records.source: Can I have some eggs? I want to put them in my nest.
records.translation: 可以給我一些蛋嗎？我想把它們放進巢裡。

records.source: Hello dear. Please take your time, I'll be here all day!
records.translation: 你好，親愛的。慢慢挑，我整天都會在這裡！
值得賣的東西全都在這裡。

records.source: I found an extra roll of wallpaper from my house. It's yours for 20 eggs!
records.translation: 我在家裡找到一捲多出來的壁紙。20 顆蛋就歸你！

records.source: Found some food in the freezer. It's yours for cheap. Just don't look at the expiration date.
records.translation: 在冷凍庫裡找到了一些食物。便宜賣給你，只是別看保存期限。

records.source: I'm sorry, my selection isn't very good this year...
records.translation: 抱歉，我今年準備的東西不太好……

records.source: Hi! Um... I found some stuff. Wanna buy it!?
records.translation: 嗨！呃……我找到了一些東西。想買嗎！？

records.source: Hey, I've got a few things for sale. Let me know if anything catches your eye.
records.translation: 嘿，我有幾樣東西要賣。看中什麼就告訴我。

records.source: ---Welcome to the Skull Cavern Challenge!---^^Calico Eggs and mysterious Calico Statues have appeared throughout the caverns.^
records.translation: ---歡迎參加骷髏洞穴挑戰！---^^卡利科蛋與神祕的卡利科雕像出現在洞穴各處。^

records.source: Your "Egg Rating" determines the likelihood of finding Calico Eggs.^^"Egg Rating" increases every 5 levels down, as well as whenever you activate a Calico Statue.^
records.translation: 你的「蛋評分」會決定找到卡利科蛋的機率。^^每深入 5 層，或每啟動一座卡利科雕像，「蛋評分」都會提高。^

records.source: ...But be careful! The Calico Statues will also invoke various strange and dangerous effects!^^Visit Gil to receive prizes for achieving a high "Egg Rating".^
records.translation: ……但要小心！卡利科雕像也會引發各種奇怪又危險的效果！^^取得高額「蛋評分」後去找吉爾，就能領取獎品。^
